From f8ada189550984ee21f27be736042b74a7da1d68 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Xu YiPing <xuyiping@hisilicon.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Nov 2017 15:39:26 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] arm64: perf: remove unsupported events for Cortex-A73

bus access read/write events are not supported in A73, based on the
Cortex-A73 TRM r0p2, section 11.9 Events (pages 11-457 to 11-460).

Fixes: 5561b6c5e981 "arm64: perf: add support for Cortex-A73"
Acked-by: Julien Thierry <julien.thierry@arm.com>
Signed-off-by: Xu YiPing <xuyiping@hisilicon.com>
Signed-off-by: Will Deacon <will.deacon@arm.com>

diff --git a/arch/arm64/kernel/perf_event.c b/arch/arm64/kernel/perf_event.c
index 9eaef51f83ff..3affca3dd96a 100644
--- a/arch/arm64/kernel/perf_event.c
+++ b/arch/arm64/kernel/perf_event.c
@@ -262,12 +262,6 @@ static const unsigned armv8_a73_perf_cache_map[PERF_COUNT_HW_CACHE_MAX]
 
 	[C(L1D)][C(OP_READ)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)]	= ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_L1D_CACHE_RD,
 	[C(L1D)][C(OP_WRITE)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)]	= ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_L1D_CACHE_WR,
-
-	[C(NODE)][C(OP_READ)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)]	= ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_BUS_ACCESS_RD,
-	[C(NODE)][C(OP_WRITE)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)] = ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_BUS_ACCESS_WR,
-
-	[C(NODE)][C(OP_READ)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)]	= ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_BUS_ACCESS_RD,
-	[C(NODE)][C(OP_WRITE)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)] = ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_BUS_ACCESS_WR,
 };
 
 static const unsigned armv8_thunder_perf_cache_map[PERF_COUNT_HW_CACHE_MAX]
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `arch/arm64/kernel/perf_event.c`**
- Removed the following lines related to bus access read/write events for Cortex-A73:
  ```c
  [C(NODE)][C(OP_READ)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)] = ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_BUS_ACCESS_RD,
  [C(NODE)][C(OP_WRITE)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)] = ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_BUS_ACCESS_WR,
  ```
- The removal of these lines indicates that bus access events are not supported for the Cortex-A73 architecture, as per the Cortex-A73 Technical Reference Manual.

### Relationships
- The modifications are directly related to the previously added support for Cortex-A73, as indicated by the fix reference to commit `5561b6c5e981`. The patch corrects the earlier implementation by removing unsupported event definitions, ensuring that the performance monitoring features align with the hardware capabilities of the Cortex-A73. This change is essential for maintaining accurate performance metrics and avoiding potential misconfigurations in performance event handling.

arm64: perf: remove unsupported events for Cortex-A73

bus access read/write events are not supported in A73, based on the
Cortex-A73 TRM r0p2, section 11.9 Events (pages 11-457 to 11-460).

Fixes: 5561b6c5e981 "arm64: perf: add support for Cortex-A73"
Acked-by: Julien Thierry <julien.thierry@arm.com>
Signed-off-by: Xu YiPing <xuyiping@hisilicon.com>
Signed-off-by: Will Deacon <will.deacon@arm.com>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the inclusion of unsupported bus access read/write events in the performance event definitions for the Cortex-A73 architecture, which do not align with the specifications outlined in the Cortex-A73 Technical Reference Manual. This led to potential inaccuracies in performance monitoring and event handling for this specific architecture.

 	[C(L1D)][C(OP_WRITE)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)]	= ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_L1D_CACHE_WR,
-

Including these unsupported events can lead to inaccuracies in performance monitoring and event handling.
